notes: Full-app language switcher, English ↔ Roman Urdu (no Urdu script, no RTL): per-user language on the user record (default English), a Language selector in Settings + a quick EN/UR toggle in the header, instant apply with no reload, server-persisted via PUT /api/auth/me/language; one shared dictionary (src/lib/i18n.js, 561 keys per language) covers navigation, buttons, headings, toasts, empty states, confirmations, server errors and notification bodies — each rendered per the requesting/target user's language, stored notifications never rewritten.
